THE HOUSEHOLD ASKS
What about a 13 kWh battery?

Answer the question from this comparison, briefly: at most four sentences and under 100 words, giving the battery payback before and after the change, both exactly as written.
reply: With a 13 kWh battery, the recommendation stays "Cannot assess", the same as for the 10 kWh battery. The battery payback goes from 65.0 years to 75.0 years, because the annual saving stays at $136 while the net outlay rises from $8,806 to $10,173. That payback falls outside the 10-year warranty by 65.0 years and outside your expected 20 years in the home by 55.0 years. These figures are partial: a charge on your bill is not priced, so they cover energy only and cannot decide the answer.
